stories.title: As uitstrooien in de Efteling 'komt incidenteel voor', ook al mag het niet

en.title: Scattering ashes at Efteling 'occurs occasionally', although it is not permitted
en.summary: Scattering the ashes of a deceased family member or friend at Efteling theme park is not allowed, yet a park spokesperson states it happens occasionally. The park considers the practice inappropriate.

stories.title: Tienduizenden mensen bij klimaatmars Amsterdam: 'Wij drammen wél door, Rob'

en.title: Tens of thousands of people at climate march Amsterdam: 'We will persist, Rob'
en.summary: Over 40,000 people participated in a climate march in Amsterdam, according to organizers, significantly fewer than the 85,000 attendees at the 2023 edition. Police and municipal authorities did not provide attendance figures.

stories.title: As strooien in Efteling mag niet, maar 'komt incidenteel voor', zegt pretpark

en.title: Scattering ashes at Efteling is not permitted, but 'occurs occasionally', says theme park
en.summary: Efteling theme park does not permit scattering ashes of deceased relatives but acknowledges it happens occasionally. Former employees reported witnessing ash scattering at attractions including Droomvlucht.

stories.title: Duizenden mensen bij klimaatmars in Amsterdam: 'Holy moly, stop met olie'

en.title: Thousands of people at climate march in Amsterdam: 'Holy moly, stop with oil'
en.summary: Around 40,000 climate activists marched from Dam Square to Museumplein in Amsterdam, demanding an end to fossil fuels and accelerated transition to clean energy. Participants carried signs with slogans protesting oil use.

stories.title: Verenigde Staten geven zeventig topgeheime briefings vrij over Bin Laden

en.title: United States releases seventy top-secret briefings about Bin Laden
en.summary: Twenty-five years after the September 11, 2001 attacks, newly declassified presidential briefings reveal that Bin Laden posed a known threat, though specific concrete dangers were never clearly identified.

stories.title: Franse autoriteiten vermoeden sabotage bij ontspoorde trein in het noorden van het land

en.title: French authorities suspect sabotage in train derailment in northern France
en.summary: French authorities are investigating a train derailment in the country's north as a suspected case of sabotage.

stories.title: Doden busongeluk Zwitserland zijn vier vrouwen en een man; eerste gewonden dit weekeinde gerepatrieerd

en.title: Bus accident deaths in Switzerland are four women and one man; first injured repatriated this weekend
en.summary: Five Dutch nationals died in a bus accident in Switzerland on Thursday. The victims consist of four women and one man, all over 70 years old, from various locations in the Netherlands.

stories.title: Familie Jade Kops wordt bedreigd: 'Pas maar op, we weten waar ze ligt'

en.title: Family of Jade Kops receives threats: 'Be careful, we know where she is'
en.summary: The parents of Jade Kops, who died in April, are being threatened by people demanding contact. Police are conducting interviews with individuals involved in the threats.

stories.title: Vermoedens van sabotage bij ontspoorde trein in Noordwest-Frankrijk

en.title: Suspicions of sabotage in train derailment in northwest France
en.summary: A train derailment north of France that injured 44 people is believed to have resulted from sabotage, with authorities suspecting a metal rail section was deliberately placed on the tracks near Oissel-sur-Seine.

stories.title: Céline Dion zet Parijs op z'n kop met concertreeks die een tijd onmogelijk leek

en.title: Céline Dion shakes up Paris with concert series that seemed impossible for a time
en.summary: Céline Dion makes her comeback performance in Paris on Saturday, her first concert since 2020. The concert series is a significant achievement given her recent health challenges.

stories.title: Doden busongeluk Zwitserland zijn vier vrouwen en een man, allen ouder dan 70

en.title: Bus accident deaths in Switzerland are four women and one man, all over 70
en.summary: Five Dutch nationals died in a bus accident in Switzerland on Thursday. All victims are over 70 years old and originate from different parts of the Netherlands.

stories.title: Vier vrouwen en een man dodelijke slachtoffers busongeluk Zwitserland

en.title: Four women and one man killed in Swiss bus accident
en.summary: Five Dutch nationals died in a bus accident in eastern Switzerland on Thursday. The victims included women aged 71, 79, 80, and 75, and a man aged 75. Forty other passengers were injured, with ten remaining hospitalized.
